title: Solstice world generation contract
description: Realm generation parameters. Truth: docs/setting/WORLD.md SS2.1 (scale), SS2.4 (world roll), SS3.3 (generation flow). Read at runtime from game/Config/Solstice/Data/world.json. One tile is one metre. `default` is the safe recipe; `presets` are recipes that lock a few axes and carry no fixed seed.

generator_version.description: Bump whenever generation output changes; required to reproduce an old save exactly.

sky.description: Celestial content of this realm. Position / visual diameter are fixed by WORLD SS1.1; only count, colour and presence are rolled.

realm_id.description: Stable identity of the realm, e.g. realm.rolled.

size.description: Tiles per axis. 512 is the default tier; 128 is the sandbox / bench tier (WORLD SS2.1).

chunk_size.description: Tiles per chunk side; drives the dirty-region rebuild granularity.

algo.description: Base height field. In the roll it is one axis, not the whole generation (see R-29).

seed.description: 0 = roll a fresh world every new game; any other value pins that exact world. Human-readable form is SOL-XXXX-XXXX.

land_ratio.description: Land share of the disc. 0 = ocean world, 1 = all-land world; both are legal, judged by the seven readability criteria (WORLD SS2.4).

bearing.description: Overall orientation of ranges and valleys, degrees.

latitude.description: Drives the solar path and the season when the reality anchor is offline.

weather_bias.description: Weights the weather state machine's entry probabilities.

biome_pool.description: Which biomes this realm may contain; filtered by climate feasibility.

species_pool.description: Which species exist at world birth. Life is rolled, never sown by the player.

start_hour.description: Must be inside daylight; a realm never opens pitch black.
